sources.title: Better Fishing Waters
sources.claim_supported: Michigan DNR states that fisheries management biologists compiled locations offering good fishing opportunities for the indicated species; the exact rows name Pentwater Breakwall/Lake, Rogers City Harbor, Tawas City/Bay, and Caseville.
sources.permitted_use: Primary exact-city occurrence and qualitative targetability evidence; it can support a research lead and, with recurring local mode evidence, Grade B admission.
sources.limitations: The table does not quantify catch rate, season, effort, or always isolate a pier/wall. A city or bay row alone cannot establish covered-structure magnitude or a full-year numeric shape.

sources.title: Creel Sportfishing Estimates dashboard

sources.title: Light List Volume VII / live Great Lakes data

sources.title: Beach safety

sources.title: Charles Mears State Park
sources.exact_geography: South end of Charles Mears State Park at the north side of the Pentwater channel
sources.claim_supported: Accessible fishing pier at the south end of the park; a 2026 DNR program calls it the Pentwater Lake Channel Pier.
sources.limitations: The reviewed page does not map whether the accessible facility is fully coextensive with the federal north navigation pier; same-day gate/wave status is absent.
